pages.text: The matter condenser can be used as either a trash can or to create $(l:items_blocks_machines/matter_ball)Matter Ball$(/l)s and $(l:items_blocks_machines/singularities)singularities$(/l). It can take any item or fluid or etc. a storage cell can store.

pages.title: Settings/Recipes
pages.text: $(li)In trash can mode, the matter condenser just voids everything that enters it$(li)In matter ball mode the condenser makes $(l:items_blocks_machines/matter_ball)Matter Ball$(/l)s out of whatever you put in it. This mode requires that you put a storage component in the top slot of the condenser. Matter balls take 256 items or buckets each, so a $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)1k ME Storage Component$(/l) (which provides 8192 bits of capacity) is more than enough.

$(li)In matter singularity mode the condenser makes $(l:items_blocks_machines/singularities)singularities$(/l) out of whatever you put in it. This mode requires that you put a storage component in the top slot of the condenser. Singularities take 256,000 items or buckets each, so a $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)64k ME Storage Component$(/l) (which provides 524,288 bits of capacity) is more than enough.$(br2)Note that in the latter two modes where some resource is
produced, the Matter Condenser $(o)can$() back up and will not accept any further input if both the energy and output item buffers are completely filled up.
